objective: Produce at least one visibly recognizable simple-logo QR candidate that passes automated decoder validation while testing three treatments across 2/4/6/8 percent budgets.

criteria.evidence: Diamond background-silhouette and module-recolor candidates visibly recognizable in visual-contact-sheet.png.
Both strongest diamond candidates passed 8/8 jsQR perturbation cases.
Central logo-pixel, background silhouette, and module recolor tested.
No physical scan performed or claimed.

iterations.hypothesis: Concentrated and non-destructive treatments can outperform global 12% binary perforation.
Color-based target composition can preserve the binary QR matrix and improve recognition.
Binary central mutation remains safe through all 6–8% settings.
